title: MCEval: A Dynamic Framework for Fair Multilingual Cultural Evaluation of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Dynamic question construction using counterfactual rephrasing (altering causal cultural elements to flip the expected answer) and confounder rephrasing (altering irrelevant elements like an actor's nationality) to evaluate LLMs on cultural stereotypes and norms across 13 cultures.

Comparing LLM performance on cultural awareness and bias detection tasks across native languages, English, and cross-lingual settings to measure linguistic performance disparities and expose evaluation unfairness.
